preserved_strengths: realized-mapping rather than metadata-only permutation requirement
exact slot-level counterbalancing and near-zero class-slot MI
retention protection for already measured semantic-read/write/carrier functions

round_1_findings.finding: Perfect balance over placeholder slots ATOM_A/B/C does not guarantee independence between semantic class and the actual 46 accepted ABI atom identities after materialization.
round_1_findings.failure_mode: A biased atom allocator can preserve zero class-slot MI while creating exploitable class-real-atom frequency leakage.
round_1_findings.repair: Freeze an exact atom partition/materialization schedule and validate class-real-atom contingency and MI on realized rows.

round_1_findings.finding: A CODEBOOK_FLIP pair is not a clean causal discriminator if the materializer redraws the real atom triplet while changing the class-symbol permutation.
round_1_findings.failure_mode: The pair simultaneously changes routing and symbol identity, so a behavioral difference cannot be attributed to mapping alone.
round_1_findings.repair: Hold semantic case, lexical realization, template, atom triplet and relevant presentation policy fixed; vary only the realized S3 class↔atom mapping.

round_1_findings.finding: A symbol reserved for unseen-symbol evaluation is contaminated if it appears anywhere model-visible in training, even only as a non-target codebook entry.
round_1_findings.repair: Partition exact accepted atom identities and prohibit validation/holdout atoms from every model-visible training prompt and target.

round_1_findings.finding: Counterfactual variants of one base episode can leak across splits if split logic keys on concrete prompt strings rather than shared causal/provenance ancestry.
round_1_findings.repair: Bind all variants to one counterfactual_family_id and provenance_ancestry_id; split at that family level.

round_1_findings.finding: Three codebook lines are insufficient unless the materialized mapping uses three distinct accepted atoms.
round_1_findings.repair: Reject any non-injective three-class codebook and exclude the measured rejected atom 'or'.

swarm.round_2_adjudication: The existing v2 seed contract remains the correct base. Add atom-identity-level balancing, immutable symbol partitions and counterfactual-family materialization invariants before any 72-row materialization is admitted.

supplemental_training_seed.purpose: Teach and test materialization invariants that slot-level seed balance alone does not cover.

deterministic_validation.method: Re-evaluated all 12 rows locally against the exact fetched v1 gate predicates; supplemental static audits then checked intended evidence class, fact-status boundary, family/provenance split unit and no positive J-Space targets.
deterministic_validation.boundary: Candidate-row source validation only; no canonical dataset admission or model/runtime/training credit.

new_materialization_gates: SYMBOL_PARTITION_MANIFEST: exact 46 accepted atom identities partitioned before tuning with source/ABI/tokenizer hashes.
NO_CROSS_PARTITION_VISIBILITY: validation/holdout atoms absent from every model-visible training position.
REAL_ATOM_COUNTERBALANCE: audit class↔actual-atom counts, target counts, codebook-position counts and class↔actual-atom MI.
COUNTERFACTUAL_FAMILY_CLOSURE: mapping/order/semantic/paraphrase variants from one base episode remain in one split and share family ancestry.
CODEBOOK_FLIP_ISOLATION: same atom triplet and semantic/lexical case; only realized S3 mapping changes.
ORDER_SHUFFLE_ISOLATION: same realized mapping and target; only display order changes.
INJECTIVE_CODEBOOK: three distinct accepted atom identities per three-class episode.
REJECTED_ATOM_EXCLUSION: measured rejected atom 'or' is never materialized.

research_feedback.training_rule: Counterfactual family design must extend through the physical symbol materialization layer; balancing abstract slots is not enough.
research_feedback.architecture_implication: The proposed binder should be evaluated as a mapping operator invariant to symbol identity and codebook presentation, not merely as a classifier that happens to emit learned atoms.
research_feedback.statistical_implication: The correct anti-shortcut statistic is multi-level: class↔slot and class↔real-atom independence, plus atom↔position and atom↔target frequency audits.
research_feedback.falsifier: If performance collapses when atom identities are held out or remapped despite perfect slot-level training balance, the model learned symbol-specific shortcuts rather than a content-dependent binding operator.
research_feedback.harness_implication: The future Xeno harness should preserve counterfactual_family_id, exact atom_triplet_id, realized_mapping_digest and output atom identity so mapping lesions/rescues can be attributed causally.

next_exact_actions: Acquire or expose the exact 46 accepted ABI atom identities under the already bound source-package/manifest hashes.
Freeze a deterministic symbol-partition manifest before row materialization or pilot tuning.
Implement the 72-row materializer so counterfactual families hold real atom triplets constant where required and split by ancestry.
Run slot-level plus actual-atom-level counterbalance/MI/leakage validators before admitting any generated rows.
Only after those gates pass, expand lexical families and proceed to matched Base-vs-post-trained pilot evaluation without touching frozen holdouts.
